verdict_reason: Prior HIGH (CWE-22, `fold_release` accepting a traversal-shaped `folded_id` on an existence check alone) closed by df9d89da. Read `git show df9d89da` in full: the diff touches exactly two files, dadaia_workspace/features/specs/candidate.py (8 insertions, 0 deletions) and tests/unit/features/specs/test_candidate_fold.py (19 insertions, 0 deletions) -- no other file, confirmed by `git diff --numstat df9d89da~1 df9d89da`. The added guard `if not is_release_semver(folded_id): raise ArchiveError(...)` is the FIRST statement in `fold_release`'s body, appearing before `archive_root = specs_dir / 'releases' / '_archive'` and `folded_dir = archive_root / folded_id` -- both path-join sites now execute strictly after the refusal, never before. `is_release_semver` (dadaia_workspace/core/specs_version.py:100) matches the fully-anchored `RELEASE_SEMVER_RE = re.compile(r'^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z.]*)?$')` and additionally refuses any `v`-prefixed value -- a two-dot parent-reference segment prepended to a version-shaped suffix cannot match this pattern (it contains characters and a leading segment the anchored regex forbids), so the guard is airtight for path-segment-shaped payloads, not merely a denylist of one string. The one caller of `fold_release` (dadaia_workspace/cli/commands/newartifacts.py:332) passes the CLI `folded_id` argument straight through with no prior validation or path construction, so the new guard is the sole and first checkpoint on that argument. New test `test_a_traversal_shaped_id_is_refused_before_any_path_is_built` constructs the exact live-release-targeting traversal id named in the prior finding, asserts `ArchiveError` with the refusal message, and asserts the specs tree is byte-identical (`sorted(rglob('*'))` before/after) plus the live release directory and its state document still exist. Independent reproduction on a scratch tmp tree (not the committed fixture) with a synthetic live release and a synthetic ARCHIVED target, calling `fold_release` directly with the same traversal-shaped id: raises `ArchiveError` naming the id as not a bare SemVer archived release id; the tmp tree's file listing is identical before and after; the live release directory and its state document are untouched -- confirms the refusal fires before any `Path` join, `mkdir`, `shutil.move` or `shutil.rmtree` is reachable, closing the exploitable window the prior REJECTED verdict identified. Ran `pytest tests/unit/features/specs/test_candidate_fold.py tests/contract/test_release_tree_canon.py tests/unit/features/specs -q -p no:cacheprovider` -> 304 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. findings.message: RESOLVED by df9d89da: fold_release accepted a traversal-shaped folded_id on an existence check alone (CWE-22), reachable via the release fold CLI verb, risking an rmtree outside _archive/.
findings.detail_md: Originally raised on this agent's REJECTED delta verdict for commit d564e213 (not committed to disk, since only APPROVED verdicts are recorded under specs/releases/<id>/verdicts/). In b14b577c's `fold_release`, `archive_root / folded_id` was joined and `.is_dir()`-checked before any shape validation on `folded_id`, so a two-dot parent-reference segment naming a real directory carrying a state document -- including the live release's own directory one level up from _archive/ -- would pass the existence check and reach the function's later `shutil.move`/`shutil.rmtree` calls. Closed in df9d89da: `is_release_semver(folded_id)` is now the first statement in the function body, refusing any non-bare-SemVer id (including any two-dot or slash-bearing segment) before `archive_root` or `folded_dir` is ever constructed. Verified line-by-line in `git show df9d89da`, by an independent reproduction on a scratch tree, and by the new regression test `test_a_traversal_shaped_id_is_refused_before_any_path_is_built`, which proves the specs tree stays byte-identical and the live release survives.
findings.fix_recommendation: None required -- already fixed in df9d89da. No further action.
